opportunities.title: Denmark's ID Register Just Leaked More People Than Denmark Has
opportunities.why_now: 8.8 million CPR records exposed via a single company account in a nation of 6 million is the kind of absurd breach math that defines the 'inevitable breach' beat.
opportunities.angle: Short punchy breach-math post: show the leaked record count vs population, then zoom into the 'one company account' root cause as the real lesson.

opportunities.title: The FBI Just Named the Accenture Contractor Who Missed One Patch
opportunities.why_now: The FBI publicly blamed a specific contractor's missed patch for the ShinyHunters breach and then removed them — a rare public accountability moment in patch-cadence failures.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence postmortem: timeline from missed CVE to breach to contractor firing, framed as 'this is what happens when patch SLAs slip.'

opportunities.title: Atlassian's 'Critical' Just Means Read Any File, Unauthenticated, Across 8 Products
opportunities.why_now: A fresh critical file-access flaw spanning eight Atlassian Data Center products is an immediate patch-now story with broad enterprise blast radius.
opportunities.angle: CVE explainer with a patch-priority checklist: which 8 products, what the unauthenticated read actually exposes, and a 'patch by Friday' countdown framing.

opportunities.title: FortiBleed Won't Die: FBI Confirms Attacks Are Still Draining Fortinet Boxes
opportunities.why_now: The FBI's fresh confirmation that FortiBleed exploitation is ongoing, long after disclosure, is the perfect case study for the channel's 'inevitable breach' thesis about patch lag.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence autopsy: how long the vuln has been known, who's still unpatched, and why 'patch available' never equals 'patch applied.'

opportunities.title: Citrix NetScaler's 0-Day Pileup Just Got Worse — Here's Who's Still Exposed
opportunities.why_now: New 0-day reports stacking on top of existing NetScaler issues signal an active, worsening exploitation window that enterprises need to act on now.
opportunities.angle: Threat-actor tracker format: what's being exploited in the wild right now, overlap with prior CVEs, and a blunt 'if you run NetScaler, do this today' list.
